# If you buy a duplex, triplex or fourplex and live in one unit, what does it really cost you?

> Free house hacking calculator for a duplex, triplex or fourplex: FHA or conventional payment with mortgage insurance, the rent you need to live free, the FHA self-sufficiency test, and the 10-year return versus renting. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
